product: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW will soon preserve grants, comments and tags by default
tagline: Starting December 2, 2026, CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW will update views in place, instead of dropping and re creating the view.
what_it_does: Starting December 2, 2026, CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW will update views in place, instead of dropping and re creating the view. Grants, tags, and comments are preserved with two caveats: As views execute with view owner's permissions, grants are not preserved if a non owner alters the view query via CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW You must first remove governed tags on a view column before dropping the column via CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW. Otherwise, the statement will fail with a CANNOT DROP TAGGED COLUMN error to protect the ABAC policies that depend on them (learn more).
